<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/forwards/offers/{boxId}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Return one of this wallet's offers, its LIT and ERG, to its maker address. A fill sent before the cancel can still confirm first, and the cancel is then dropped. No body.
